stem: Why did President Andrew Jackson oppose the Second Bank of the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: He believed it was inefficient and poorly managed.

options.label: B
options.text: He thought it was unconstitutional and favored the wealthy.

options.label: C
options.text: He considered it an obstacle to industrial progress and expansion.

options.label: D
options.text: He believed it favored the rights of states over the federal government.
